previous_candidate.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one transparent PNG monster miniature for a tactical tabletop videogame, readable at 64 pixels.
Primary request: create ONE KING COBRA token in the same hand-painted miniature family as style reference 1.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved BROWN SNAKE token STYLE reference only (neutral dark gray-brown shallow disc, high overhead oblique camera, matte painted sculptural material, soft upper-left lighting). Image 2 is the original KING COBRA game sprite IDENTITY reference (green cobra); game description explicitly calls it a large snake with a hooded face. This is a NEW species: do not copy the brown snake's head or low-coil pose.
Subject: an olive-green king cobra with a large unmistakable expanded neck hood and a raised forward body. Broad pale warm-cream front of hood, green patterned outer edges, a single sharp snake head angled toward the viewer. Lower body forms one compact loose coil supporting the broad hood. The hood is the dominant shape, not a long clutter of loops. No crown, ornaments, extra heads, horns, limbs, armor or weapons.
Style: painted carved wood/resin fantasy game piece, simplified chunky shapes, a few expressive brush highlights. Species must be distinguishable by silhouette from a low brown coiled snake at 64px.
Composition: high overhead oblique view showing head and back. Place whole creature safely inside a neutral shallow nearly circular gray-brown base. IMPORTANT: even the highest part of the raised hood remains INSIDE the base outline in the image plane; tilt its body toward viewer if needed. Base rim is visible all around. Square image, complete base about 86% of canvas width, centered. Creature large, occupying most of base, not a tiny miniature. All contour remains within one circular token.
Lighting: soft upper-left, short contact shadow only inside disc. Matte finish, no glow.
Background: genuine fully transparent PNG alpha outside the disc, clean corners and transparent space; no water, grass, scenery, surface, supports or drop shadow beyond disc.
Avoid: faction-colored ring, red rim, blue rim, colored status glow, letters, numbers, labels, rank stars, watermark. Creature coloring only; base is neutral.
